label: Screen Skill V2 kit global catalog

branches.label: Top navigation
branches.usage: Use nav.png as pure background; inject title, optional subtitle, time, weather and secondary labels with DOM. Subtitle is rendered only when the selected meta enables it.

branches.label: Shell components
branches.usage: Runtime must read component.html, shell.css and meta.json. CardShell style must be locked per screen; do not mix multiple CardShell styles in one generated screen unless the user explicitly requests it. PanelShell is mainly for center visual backgrounds or frames without a card title.

branches.label: Design widgets
branches.usage: Only KPI card is kept as a local design widget. Read widget/kpi-card/catalog.json, then use base.css plus the selected StyleXX component/style/meta. Inject KPI widgets into shell content slots. Charts, tables, rankings, alerts, maps, big numbers, tasks and event lists are runtime-rendered and must not be read from kit/widget.

branches.label: Runtime renderers
branches.usage: Use local ECharts 5.6.1 plus chart presets for charts. Use table-renderers.js and CSS for tables, rankings, alerts, tasks and event lists. Do not call external design tools for these modules.

branches.label: Map data resources
branches.usage: Use local GeoJSON map data for ECharts registerMap. For China maps, copy china.geo.json to the generated screen assets/map directory and fetch it locally; keep TopoJSON only as source data.

branches.label: Screen background
branches.usage: Prefer ready background images by theme; use cssFallback when image is pending or missing.

selectionRules.themeUse: Use theme id, aliases and CSS tokens for visual compatibility. Do not use business category for kit selection.
selectionRules.sourceMapUse: Runtime generation must not read maintenance source maps or external design sources.
selectionRules.businessCategoryUse: Business category is only for mock data, metric naming, business grouping and copy generation.

rules.selection: Always read this global catalog first, then read branch catalogs and final meta.json files.
rules.fallback: When a branch, catalog item, or ready asset is missing, generate a CSS fallback and record it in change-log.
rules.noGuessing: Never reference kit paths that are not present in this catalog or a branch catalog.
